data.title: Gym membership confirmation – MusterFit "Flex Premium"
data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH confirms Mara Beispiel's "Flex Premium" gym membership, starting 1 March 2026 with a 12-month minimum term and a monthly fee of €34.90, collected by direct debit.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your new gym contract with MusterFit; no action is needed now. The membership runs for a minimum of 12 months, after which it continues indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with one month's notice (cancellation button in the app or by email). The monthly fee of €34.90 will be collected automatically in advance by direct debit, so make sure your account has sufficient funds. Keep this letter for your records, especially the membership and contract numbers, in case you need to cancel or have a dispute later.
